examples: The old folk sat outside in the sun.
She collects folk songs from the north.
semantic_expansions: 人们：泛指一群人，不特别指谁
民间的：出自这些人手里，不是官方的
乡亲：跟你同一个地方出来的那些人
民歌：这些人口口相传唱下来的调子

words.origin: 古英语 folgian（跟在后面走）← 原始日耳曼语 *fulgōjan
words.native_definition: to move or happen after someone or something
words.core_concept: keeping behind and taking the same line – 待在后面，走同一条线
words.core_image: 小鸭排成一列贴着母鸭走，前面一拐，后面几只也跟着拐
examples: The dog followed me all the way home.
Please follow the instructions carefully.
semantic_expansions: 跟随：走在后面，保持同一条路线
遵循：照着规定或指示走，不自己另走
听懂：能一步步跟上对方的思路
接着发生：一件事排在另一件后头出现

words.origin: 中古英语 fonned（fonnen 犯傻 的过去分词）← fon（傻子），更早词源不明
words.native_definition: having a warm liking for someone or something
words.core_concept: a warmth that softens one's judgement – 一份让人下不了狠心的暖意
words.core_image: 奶提起孙子，眼角先软下来，语速也慢了，话绕着他转
examples: She is fond of her little brother.
He has fond memories of that summer.
semantic_expansions: 喜爱的：心里对某人某物发暖
深情的：这份暖存在回忆里，隔很久还在
宠溺的：暖过了头，明知不对也舍不得管

words.origin: 古英语 fōda ← 原始日耳曼语 *fōdō（吃的东西）
words.native_definition: anything that people or animals eat to stay alive
words.core_concept: what goes in to keep the body running – 送进嘴里维持身子运转的东西
words.core_image: 一碗热饭配两样菜端上桌，人坐下就动筷子
examples: We bought food for the whole week.
The plant needs water and food.
semantic_expansions: 食物：吃进嘴、养住身体的那些东西
食品：做好装好、拿来卖的那一类
养料：植物和土里对应的那份，也是供它活着的

words.origin: 由 fool 加 -ish 构成；fool ← 古法语 fol ← 晚期拉丁语 follis（风箱、空袋）
words.native_definition: lacking good sense or judgement
words.core_concept: acting with nothing thought through first – 脑子里空着就动手
words.core_image: 那人把最后一点钱押在一张牌上，周围人直摇头
examples: It was foolish to go out in the storm.
He felt foolish after the mistake.
semantic_expansions: 愚蠢的：想都没想就做，自己吃亏
不明智的：明有更稳的路，偏不走
可笑的：做出来的样子让旁人想笑

words.origin: 古英语 fōt ← 原始日耳曼语 *fōtuz
words.native_definition: the part of the body at the end of the leg, or the bottom of something
words.core_concept: the part that stands on the ground – 站在地面上的那一部分
words.core_image: 鞋脱掉，底下沾着沙，五根趾头在地板上张开又收回
examples: My left foot hurts when I walk.
They camped at the foot of the mountain.
semantic_expansions: 脚：腿末端着地那一段
足部：同一处，更书面的说法
底部：一件东西最下面挨着地的那头
英尺：以这一段的长度为准定出的尺寸

words.native_definition: a game in which two teams try to kick a ball into a goal
words.core_concept: a ball game played with the feet – 一种用脚玩的球赛
words.core_image: 一群人在草地上追着黑白相间的球跑，谁都不许用手接
examples: The boys played football after school.
He kicked the football over the fence.

橄榄球：美国用同一个词指抱着跑的那种

words.native_definition: the sound or mark made by a foot when walking
words.core_concept: the mark or sound left by one tread – 落下一步留下的响或印
words.core_image: 空走廊里传来一下一下的声响，越来越近，听得出穿的是皮鞋
examples: I heard footsteps behind me.
He followed in his father's footsteps.
semantic_expansions: 脚步：走路时脚落地的那一下
脚步声：那一下发出来的响
足迹：那一下在地上留下的印，也指走过的路子

words.origin: 古英语 forbēodan（for- 禁绝 + bēodan 命令、宣告）
words.native_definition: to order someone not to do something
words.core_concept: an order with a no in front of it – 一道命令，前面加了个不
words.core_image: 门上贴着一张红叉划掉的纸，守门的人伸手把要进去的挡住
examples: Her parents forbade her to go out alone.
Smoking is forbidden in this building.
semantic_expansions: 禁止：正式下令，这件事不许做
不许：当面拦住某人做某事
阻止：条件本身把这条路堵上了

words.core_concept: the end that goes first – 最先过去的那一头
